messages:
anna: Quick sync — onboarding plan for q4f-compact. want to add a deterministic sample check + artifact metadata lint before bench.
tom: yep. propose two new preflight gates: 1) metadata schema validation (quant-tag, vocab-hash, compile-flags) 2) deterministic-sample-replay (run 5 fixed seeds, compare outputs).
raj: +1. For deterministic replay, do we run full bench or just smoke samples? keeping it short matters.
emma: smoke only (10 samples) but include one adversarial long prompt to exercise kv-paths.
anna: good call. also, we saw weird tokenization drift last time — add `token-vocab-checksum` to metadata and fail if mismatch.
tom: implemented as part of artifact-lint: `quant_tag` must be one of [q4f,q4_0,q8], `vocab_hash` required, `token_checksum` required.
infra-bot: INFRA: artifact-lint image built (sha: b9a2f3) — available in canary pool.
raj: bench smoke config: `bench --model=q4f-compact --set=smoke-lite --runs=10 --seeds=1,2,3,4,5 --kv-probe`
emma: add `--kv-probe-threshold=0.03` so we can flag high miss rates.
anna: rollout rule suggestion: if median latency delta > 7% OR token_checksum mismatch OR kv_miss_rate > 3% -> block canary.
tom: question: how do we compute median delta? vs which baseline? need baseline per model family.
raj: baseline is the most recent registered stable variant for that family (lookup in registry:family_baselines).
emma: telemetry note — surface `determinism_failure_count` and `kv_miss_rate` in the console for the version. ops-bot can wire alerts.
ops-bot: ALERTS: will create alert `onboard.det_check_failures` with severity=warn if determinism_failures>0 during admit.
anna: one more: include a small embedding parity check (same prompts -> embeddings cos_sim > 0.995). quant can change embeddings slightly.
tom: good idea. add `embedding_cos_threshold=0.995` to smoke-run.
raj: edgecase: some legacy models have vocab normalization differences. config should allow `allow_vocab_minor_diff: true` with a whitelist in registry to avoid blocking older variants.
emma: i'll add that to registry schema and document the exception list.
anna: ok action items: tom add artifact-lint rules + update ingest hook; raj add deterministic-sample runner to bench harness; emma add kv-probe flag and registry whitelist support; ops-bot create alert. We'll run a full smoke tomorrow 10:00 PT on small-gpu.
tom: i'll open PRs and tag reviewers.
infra-bot: SCHEDULE: small-gpu reservation confirmed for 2025-03-12T10:00 PT.
anna: thanks all. keeping this short — we want minimal false-positives but catch token/kv regressions early. :+1:
